text: PM Le Minh Hung attends ASEAN-US Special Summit, holds bilateral talks with US President

Prime Minister Le Minh Hung on November 17 joined ASEAN leaders and US President Donald Trump at the ASEAN-US Special Summit, held on the sidelines of the 49th ASEAN Summit and related meetings in Manila, the Philippines, reported the Government News.

At the summit, leaders noted that the ASEAN-US Comprehensive Strategic Partnership continues to expand across political, economic and trade cooperation, as well as emerging priority areas such as the digital economy, artificial intelligence (AI), critical minerals and the development of secure and resilient supply chains.
The US is currently ASEAN's second-largest partner in both two-way trade and foreign direct investment (FDI).
In 2025, bilateral trade reached $550.5 billion, while total US FDI inflows into ASEAN amounted to nearly $30 billion.
ASEAN leaders highly appreciated the contributions of the US and President Trump to regional peace, stability and prosperity.
President Trump reaffirmed the US' commitment to ASEAN and pledged to further strengthen cooperation in areas of mutual benefit.

Leaders agreed to effectively implement the ASEAN-US Plan of Action for 2026-2030 and to organize meaningful activities to commemorate the 50th anniversary of ASEAN-US Dialogue Relations and the fifth anniversary of the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership in 2027.
Addressing the summit, Prime Minister Hung welcomed the US' commitments and President Trump's personal support for ASEAN.

To further advance the ASEAN-US Comprehensive Strategic Partnership, the Vietnamese Government's leader proposed that both sides continue prioritizing balanced, sustainable and mutually beneficial economic and trade relations, while making the digital economy, artificial intelligence and cybersecurity key areas of cooperation.
He also emphasized the importance of strengthening political foundations and elevating cooperation for shared peace and security.
During bilateral talks with President Trump, PM Hung expressed appreciation for the President's attention to and direction in promoting Vietnam-US relations.
He proposed that the two sides maintain constructive discussions with a view to concluding a reciprocal trade agreement at an early date.
President Trump took note of the Prime Minister's proposals and instructed relevant agencies to continue studying and discussing them with the Vietnamese side.
On the occasion, PM Hung thanked President Trump for inviting General Secretary and President To Lam to attend the G20 Summit in Miami in December 2026.
He also extended an invitation to President Trump to visit Vietnam and attend the APEC 2027 Economic Leaders' Week.
At the summit, ASEAN and US leaders adopted a Joint Statement on Ten Public-Private Partnership Principles to Combat Online Fraud and Scams.
